verdict.rationale: Decagon's Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) let support-ops teams define agent behavior in natural language 'the same way you train human agents with SOPs,' with non-technical teams architecting and iterating on branching agent logic, auto-generated from past interactions, and testable via Duet. This directly matches encoding SOPs with deterministic branching for known issue types, though missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the branching logic's determinism and no public technical docs detailing the exact conditional/branching syntax (docs.decagon.ai is login-gated).
